gen-gf-revalia-gf-stack-sans-notch: Loud, loose and wide-striding, Revalia sets a bold tone up top. Stack Sans Notch follows with rod-stock strokes and big-bodied lowercase, so a long block of text glides by under the eye like wire.
gen-megrim-gf-alexandria: Megrim looks like bent tubing, every stroke cut to one measured thickness. Alexandria brings wide terminals and a tall body with short stems, so paragraphs of text move along smoothly.
gen-megrim-gf-anek-devanagari: Megrim's round letters have rims that match their stems, giving a spare, angular look. Anek Devanagari keeps its letter mouths distinctly open and its middle zone tall, so long reading flows without snagging.
gen-megrim-gf-carrois-gothic: Carrois Gothic sits high on its x-height and opens its curves generously, giving text a modern feel. And paragraphs read smoothly under Megrim, whose curves never swell past its straight stems.
gen-megrim-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Megrim never varies its stroke weight, and that angular, futuristic rigidity is what you notice first. Carrois Gothic SC leaves a clear opening at every curve's end, so reading feels approachable.
gen-megrim-gf-chivo: Megrim draws plain, unshaded lines that never swell, which gives its headings an angular, futuristic edge. Chivo packs its lowercase up toward the caps and lets daylight through every curve, so text reads friendly and steady.
gen-megrim-gf-chocolate-classical-sans: Megrim shows no stroke contrast whatsoever, with every angular, futuristic line ending at one measured thickness. Chocolate Classical Sans brings sizable lowercase and broad-nibbed strokes that never curl shut.
gen-megrim-gf-duru-sans: Duru Sans reads generously, its small letters dominating every line. Megrim above it keeps its joins full-strength and its angles sharp, a futuristic cap on that body of text.
gen-megrim-gf-funnel-sans: Strokes keep their width from stem to curve, every e pried open. Funnel Sans sits beneath Megrim's angular, futuristic headings with ascenders tucked tight to the x-height line, a quiet counterweight.
gen-megrim-gf-gafata: Futuristic and angular, Megrim sets every stroke at one measured thickness, while Gafata keeps a tall band of letters with short stalks. Rigid lines above, wide-eyed e's below: that gap is the appeal.
